$comment: The test stage, started from the start menu's Test stage button. Every field is explained in test-stage.md beside this file. As committed, China's three heroes against Byzantium's, on the Cyclops's Cave, a map with no obstacles or mountains, with Wait on (a Skip turn comes back after two thirds of a turn); the Priest with Invocation in place of Blessing (owner, 2026-10-31); and Byzantium's tank and damage hero swapped (owner, 2026-10-31): the Barbarian a tank, speed 1, defence 3, power 2, Hew in place of Leap (his axe through a funnel, the two spaces next to him either side of one way and the space past them touching both, every unit there hit, and Shield 1 for each enemy hit, for 10 slots); the Cataphract its damage hero, speed 2, defence 2, power 2, without Armoured, Charge as built and Armour 1 for 8 slots after each charge. On both sides, the party picked on the start menu too. And the Magus with Syzygy in place of Omen (owner, 2026-10-31): one of his six lines, any distance, through anything, the cards of every unit on it rearranged on the track, each on any blank card or swapped among themselves; pick him on the start menu to play it.
